introduce.name: how-it-works
introduce.title: How the AI kitchen designer works
introduce.description: You don't rebuild your room from scratch here. Upload the kitchen you already have, pick a direction, and change only what you want — the walls, windows and layout stay in place.

image.alt: Bright modern kitchen with a marble island and brass details

items.title: Upload the room as it is
items.description: A clear JPG, PNG or WEBP photo, taken from where you usually stand. The shape of the room, its walls and windows are kept in every image.

items.title: Pick a style as a starting point
items.description: Choose modern, transitional, Scandinavian, Japandi and more. The style sets the direction — how far to follow it is your call.

items.title: Change only what you want to change
items.description: Keep your existing furniture or replace it. Cabinets, counters, backsplash, flooring and lighting are optional: select the ones you care about and let AI handle the rest.

items.title: Refine with a sentence, not a rebuild
items.description: After the first image, describe the next adjustment in plain words — lighter counters, warmer light — and keep each version beside the original.

faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions about AI Kitchen Design
faq.description: What to know before creating your first kitchen concept.

items.title: Can AI help me design my kitchen?
items.description: Yes. Upload a photo of your kitchen, choose a style, and AI creates a photorealistic redesign of your own space in seconds. You can then refine it in plain language.

items.title: Is the AI kitchen design tool free to use?
items.description: You can try the online kitchen designer with the free design credits included when you sign up. If you need more concepts, credit packs are available on the pricing page.

items.title: Can I keep parts of my current kitchen?
items.description: Yes. You can preserve existing furniture and use the area controls to direct specific changes.

items.title: Do I need to configure every area?
items.description: No. Areas and materials are optional. Unspecified areas can be coordinated by AI with the selected style.

items.title: Can I change a generated design?
items.description: Yes. Open a result, describe the change you want, and save the new image alongside your other results.

items.title: Are the designs construction plans?
items.description: The images are visual concepts. Confirm dimensions, building requirements, materials and installation details with qualified professionals before construction.

items.title: Where are my generated images stored?
items.description: Generated results are associated with your signed-in account so you can access them from the kitchen designer.
